title: WingFoil UI console address file (consoles/<port>.json)
description: The address file a running console keeps in the state directory (adr-003 D1, spec-006 §1), format 1, so that scripts and agents find it. Never holds a session token or session id, nor any part or hash of either, a project path, id or list, an environment value, a git identity or a credential (adr-003 D5).

format.description: The file's own version; a change of meaning bumps it.

url.description: The console's origin: always http://127.0.0.1:<port>/, the host of the printed URL (no token, no path).

port.description: The port the console listens on.

portFixed.description: Whether the port came from --port: links built on it survive a restart on the same port (adr-003 D7).

pid.description: The console's process id (judged on this host only, as state.json.lock).

started.description: When the console started listening, ISO 8601 UTC.
